text:
maria (product_designer): quick follow-up from today's design review 1: a handful of compliance-panel micro-nits before flag flip. keeping items short: audit copy, retention labels, region default affordance, encryption/KMS labeling, export columns.

sam (devex): good call. paste current audit sample so i can grep: `User updated retention policy for ws-99 to 90 days (was 30)` 1: sounds clunky.

maria (product_designer): suggestion for audit row: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by marcus (UI)` 1: actor first or last? i think actor at end is fine for table compactness.

ben (docs): prefer sentence form `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by marcus (UI)` 1: search-friendly.

linda (security): add method and resource id in the event payload (we'll store structured fields). UI string should render human friendly but JSON must have actor/method/resource.

ethan (a11y): retention select currently shows `30, 60, 90` 1: screen readers read numbers only. change visible labels to `30 days` etc and set `aria-label="Data retention period"`. compact table can use `30d` shorthand.

miguel (frontend): trivial to add i18n keys `retention.compact.30 = "30d"` and `retention.expanded.30 = "30 days"`. i'll implement and add unit tests.

maria (product_designer): KMS badge confusion: proposal table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` vs `Encrypted (BYOK)`; detail view full `Customer-managed key (BYOK)`. include lock icon with `aria-hidden=true` and accessible label `Encryption type: Customer-managed key`.

linda (security): include BYOK modal warning: "Enabling BYOK may prevent data recovery if keys are revoked. Org admins only." require checkbox `I understand BYOK responsibilities`.

ethan (a11y): ensure pill color contrast >=4.5:1 and keyboard focus for pill actions. don't use "learn more" alone as link text; use `Learn about key ownership`.

miguel (frontend): will update pills, focus styles, and tooltips. table uses compact form, detail uses expanded.

ben (docs): audit CSV request from customers: add columns `field_changed, old_value, new_value, resource_id, method, meta_json`. docs will note redaction rules.

linda (security): exports gated to org_admin/compliance role and redaction applied. add audit event `AuditExportDownloaded` with filters.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging 2026-04-01T05:00:00Z for `compliance-panel/v2` :rocket:

maria (product_designer): perfect 1: action items: miguel implements i18n + pills + modal, sam tests screen reader labels, ben updates docs, linda validates export permissions. i'll push updated artboard later today. thanks all. :seedling:
